title: Kissed Greek Honey Flatbread
description: A sweet and gooey Greek dish featuring a jammy honey filling on a long-fermentation dough bun, perfect for kids and kosher-friendly
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine flour, yeast, and salt.
Gradually add olive oil and water to the dry ingredients and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover it with a damp cloth, and let it rise in a warm place for 2 hours.
Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Punch down the dough and divide it into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a ball and flatten it slightly into a disk shape.
Place 1-2 tablespoons of honey in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the honey to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Bake the flatbreads for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown.
